topography.project_purpose: Bridge. Structurally: 45 project-authored contract(s) across 6 chain(s); 12 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 8 functional families. Its contracts share 18 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc20basic, blacklistable, standardtokenwithfees). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
